stories.extract:
By now, we all know that ultra-processed foods (UPFs) aren’t particularly good for our bodies. UPFs, which are often high in sugar, salt, saturated fat and additives, have been repeatedly linked with an increased risk of heart disease, diabetes and some cancers.
